author: ChatGPT
method: Individually authored kit objectives, item interactions, falsifications and matched-condition tests.

builds.name: Reference: Ranked mid core
builds.goal: Reference for Malzahar: the core and runes ranked Emerald+ mid players use most (13,406 ranked Emerald+ games with this core on OP.GG, patch 16.20, 52.8% win rate).
builds.hypothesis: A methodical wave and suppression mage who refreshes spreading damage and uses summoned units to pressure a marked target. The current mid provider core anchors this plan; later slots are observed options or reviewed kit completions. Core in purchase order: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter. Deathfire Touch keystone as played in those games. Remaining slots: Sorcerer's Shoes, Zhonya's Hourglass, Rabadon's Deathcap.
builds.summary: The proven mid baseline: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter, with Deathfire Touch.
testPlan: Play it in mid as your control build. Follow the purchase order; the core (Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter) is what ranked players complete first.
Record kills, deaths, damage dealt and the minute you finish each core item, then compare other builds against these numbers in similar games.
Adapt the last two items to the enemy team: armor or magic resist against fed carries, anti-heal against healing, penetration once enemies stack resists.
failureConditions: Your results with this build fall clearly below the 52.8% ranked baseline over several games in the same role.
The enemy team composition makes the core items poor answers; swap the flexible slots before abandoning the core.
tradeoffs: Proven and predictable, so opponents know what to expect. It is a starting point, not the best build for every matchup.
The observed core and individual options do not establish six-item build statistics. Late slots are kit-based inferences.
Six-slot completion is our kit-based inference, not an observed six-item win-rate build.  Situational options replace an appropriate slot; they are not added as a seventh item.
buyOrder: Core in purchase order: Blackfire Torch → Liandry's Torment → Rylai's Crystal Scepter.
Boots after the first item unless the lane needs them earlier.
coverageNotes: Source: OP.GG ranked Emerald+ solo/duo, patch 16.20, checked 2026-10-14. Core items and rune page are observed; later slots are observed options or reviewed completions. Win rates describe those games, not a prediction for yours.

Passive: Malzahar's other Abilities give him a stack when cast (max [2]).

Active: Malzahar summons a Voidling plus an additional Voidling per stack. Voidlings last [8 / 8 / 9 / 9 / 10] seconds and deal [12 / 14 / 16 / 18 / 20 + characterLevelInterpolation(5 → 64.5; raw flags preserved) + (0.4) × AD[statFormula=2] + (0.2) × AP] magic damage each hit.
Malzahar opens two portals to the Void that fire projectiles inward, dealing [70 / 105 / 140 / 175 / 210 + (0.55) × AP] magic damage and Silencing for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] second(s).

Malzahar gains [90]% damage reduction and immunity from Disabling and Immobilizing effects, lingering for [0.25] seconds after taking damage or blocking one of those effects. This effect has a [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=30, perLevel=0, changes=[{"mLevel": 6, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 11, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}, {"mLevel": 16, "mAdditionalBonusAtThisLevel": -6.0, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] second Cooldown.

Malzahar Suppresses an enemy champion and deals [125 / 200 / 275 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage over [2.5] seconds. A zone of negative energy is created around his target dealing [(2 / 3 / 4 + (0.005) × AP) × (0.05)] max Health magic damage over [5] seconds.

Malzahar inflicts terrible visions, dealing [80 / 115 / 150 / 185 / 220 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage over [4] seconds. Applying Call of the Void or Nether Grasp to the victim during this time refreshes the visions.

If the victim dies, Malzahar gains [0.02 × AbilityResource(default, statFormula=default)] Mana and the visions spread to the nearest enemy.

Malefic Visions executes minions below [characterLevelBreakpoints(start=10, perLevel=2, changes=[{"mLevel": 12, "__type": "Breakpoint"}])] Health.

builds.name: Damage interaction: AD Voidling laboratory
builds.goal: Isolate W's bonus-AD scaling rather than building AD for the whole kit
builds.summary: Isolate W's bonus-AD scaling rather than building AD for the whole kit.
builds.hypothesis: Stored Voidling hit damage includes 40% bonus AD and 20% AP and deals MAGIC damage. Raw AD and earned Muramana AD are candidates for that pet packet; Void Staff/Rylai address magic mitigation/contact. Player crit, lifesteal, lethality and Muramana on-hit effects do not automatically transfer to summons. This deliberately sacrifices strong AP spell ratios and may fail.
testPlan: Pre-cast two eligible spells for the W summon count. Fix pet lifetime, target MR and three live Voidlings; compare pet-only damage and surviving hits at matched gold against AP. Then measure the full E/Q/R sequence to expose the cost of AD.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: Summons die or fail to reach the target; AD pet damage fails to repay the loss of AP spell damage. Player item procs do not transfer as hoped.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Low-confidence farmed-role experiment: compare raw-AD components with AP first. Do not finish six items unless pet survival and damage justify it; transformation must be earned.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
coverageNotes: No numerical adapter exists for this champion. These individually authored hypotheses need manual game measurements; no global damage optimum or historical novelty is claimed.
Stored patch 26.20 source formulas are evidence, not a certified executable simulation. Resolve ambiguous tokens/stat formulas and current proc interactions before assigning numerical damage.

builds.name: Situational adaptation: Suppression that survives retaliation
builds.goal: Complete an R channel against opponents who can interrupt it
builds.summary: Complete an R channel against opponents who can interrupt it.
builds.hypothesis: Void Shift can block a disabling effect, but enemies can remove it before R. Spell-shield/positioning choices test a completed suppression; stasis is a pre/post-channel tool, not something that lets Malzahar continue channeling while invulnerable.
testPlan: Compare intact passive/spell shield versus both removed, with a second enemy interrupting. Log full channel damage, escape tools and ally follow-up. Test Q silence timing before R.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: A second enemy interrupts or the target has an appropriate suppression escape; protection arrives too late to preserve the channel.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Mana/slow checkpoint and boots, then protection for the actual interrupt; only later add penetration.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.

builds.name: Experiment: Haste-driven E handoff
builds.goal: Use repeated Q refreshes and movement to maintain useful E uptime
builds.summary: Use repeated Q refreshes and movement to maintain useful E uptime.
builds.hypothesis: Extra haste is useful when Q can refresh the E before expiration and movement keeps Malzahar within a safe casting angle. E transfers and mana returns require actual deaths; Morello targets real healing. This route optimizes delivered damage time, not the largest one-tick number.
testPlan: Compare matched-gold haste and AP routes on a moving target over ten seconds. Record Q hit rate, E refresh timing, transfers, mana and casts interrupted; repeat without kills so no free mana returns are assumed.
Use three repeatable trials at the same level, ranks, gold spent, target HP/armor/MR and incoming damage. Record the short trade and ten-second fight separately.

Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. First Strike must be ready and initiated by you; Gathering Storm uses a fixed recorded game time. Do not grant full ramp, transformed items or takedown bonuses for free.
Repeat with a moving opponent and real interruption. Compare the reference route at the same cost; log missed actions and survival as well as damage.
failureConditions: Q misses, mana runs out or haste adds no new safe refresh; antiheal is bought into a target with no healing.
Higher stationary-target damage is offset by lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: This objective is deliberately narrower than the entire champion kit; an ability ceiling is not proof of a strong overall build.
Farmed-role experiments require actual income and a viable early lane/clear. A support comparison keeps quest/vision responsibility.
Item/rune/pet/empowered-attack proc compatibility must be observed rather than inferred from a shared damage type.
buyOrder: Mana item then movement/haste if it produces another refresh. Buy antiheal only for a real healing target.
Compare a two-item checkpoint before the late six-slot illustration. Preserve movement boots unless a measured late replacement improves delivered damage.
